"""Versioned logical profiles and canonical physical chunk bindings.

V2 retains four input/output chunks. V3 permits sixteen for explicitly configured profiles.
V4 explicitly binds larger periods to the same profile and immutable physical layout.
CKKS parameters, construction work and sandbox limits remain unchanged.
"""
import math
from benchmark_graph import require,dimensions,NAME,canonical,validate,graph_resource_profile
from model_resources import identity,resolve
from unified_chunk_layout import PERIODS

ABI="unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v2"
PHYSICAL_INPUTS=4
PHYSICAL_OUTPUTS=4
EXTENDED_ABI="unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v3"
WIDE_ABI="unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v4"
WIDE_PERIODS=(512,1024,2048,4096)
EXTENDED_ABIS=(EXTENDED_ABI,WIDE_ABI)
ABIS=(ABI,*EXTENDED_ABIS)
EXTENDED_INPUTS=16
EXTENDED_OUTPUTS=16
EXTENDED_PROFILES=("resnet20-v1","general-tensors-v1")

def physical_limits(profile,execution_abi=None):
    resolve(profile)
    chosen=execution_abi if execution_abi is not None else (EXTENDED_ABI if profile in EXTENDED_PROFILES else ABI)
    require(chosen in ABIS,"Unknown capacity execution ABI")
    require(chosen not in EXTENDED_ABIS or profile in EXTENDED_PROFILES,"Extended capacity requires a configured sixteen-chunk profile")
    return (chosen,EXTENDED_INPUTS,EXTENDED_OUTPUTS) if chosen in EXTENDED_ABIS else (chosen,PHYSICAL_INPUTS,PHYSICAL_OUTPUTS)

def entry_parameter_limit(value,input_names,expected_outputs,slot_period):
    """Grant wider entry arity only from a fully validated immutable V3 layout."""
    validate_layout(value)
    require(value["execution_abi"] in EXTENDED_ABIS,"Extended entry requires capacity V3/V4")
    names=tuple(b["dsl_name"] for b in value["inputs"])+("zero_ct",)
    require(type(input_names) in (list,tuple) and tuple(input_names)==names and
            type(expected_outputs) is int and expected_outputs==value["output_ciphertexts"] and
            type(slot_period) is int and slot_period==value["input_slot_period"],
            "Extended entry/layout binding mismatch")
    return len(names)

def declarations(inputs,outputs,period,profile,execution_abi=None):
    limits=resolve(profile)
    if execution_abi is None and type(period) is int and period in WIDE_PERIODS:
        execution_abi=WIDE_ABI
    abi,max_inputs,max_outputs=physical_limits(profile,execution_abi)
    require(type(inputs) is list and 1<=len(inputs)<=limits.inputs and
            type(outputs) is list and 1<=len(outputs)<=limits.outputs,"Capacity logical I/O count")
    sizes=[]
    for entries,maximum in ((inputs,limits.input_elements),(outputs,limits.output_elements)):
        require(all(type(s) is dict and set(s)=={"name","shape"} and type(s["name"]) is str
                    and NAME.fullmatch(s["name"]) for s in entries),"Capacity tensor declaration")
        require(len({s["name"] for s in entries})==len(entries),"Duplicate capacity tensor name")
        current=[math.prod(dimensions(s["shape"],resource_profile=profile)) for s in entries]
        require(sum(current)<=maximum,"Capacity logical element budget")
        sizes.append(current)
    if period is None:
        period=next((p for p in PERIODS if sum(math.ceil(n/p) for n in sizes[0])<=max_inputs
                     and sum(math.ceil(n/p) for n in sizes[1])<=max_outputs),None)
    allowed=WIDE_PERIODS if abi==WIDE_ABI else PERIODS
    require(type(period) is int and period in allowed,"Capacity needs a configured period and bounded physical layout")
    require(sum(math.ceil(n/period) for n in sizes[0])<=max_inputs,f"Capacity input ciphertext budget (maximum {max_inputs})")
    require(sum(math.ceil(n/period) for n in sizes[1])<=max_outputs,f"Capacity output ciphertext budget (maximum {max_outputs})")
    physical=[];results=[];selectors=[];ciphertext=0
    for spec,n in zip(inputs,sizes[0]):
        for start in range(0,n,period):
            physical.append(dict(name=spec["name"],dsl_name=("x","y","z","t")[len(physical)] if abi==ABI else "x"+str(len(physical)),
                shape=spec["shape"],offset=start,elements=min(period,n-start)))
    for spec,n in zip(outputs,sizes[1]):
        chunks=[]
        for start in range(0,n,period):
            count=min(period,n-start)
            chunks.append(dict(ciphertext=ciphertext,offset=start,elements=count))
            selectors.extend([[ciphertext,i] for i in range(count)]);ciphertext+=1
        results.append(dict(name=spec["name"],shape=spec["shape"],chunks=chunks))
    return dict(execution_abi=abi,resource_profile=identity(profile),input_slot_period=period,
        logical_inputs=inputs,inputs=physical,outputs=results,output_ciphertexts=ciphertext,
        output_selectors=selectors,output_shape=[len(selectors)],output_representation="named_chunked_prefixes",
        auxiliary_ciphertexts=[dict(dsl_name="zero_ct",kind="encrypted_zero",source="trusted_client",slot_period=period)])

def layout(model,period=None,*,execution_abi=None,output_binding_policy=None):
    if output_binding_policy is not None:
        from unified_output_aliases import POLICY,layout as alias_layout
        require(output_binding_policy==POLICY,"Unknown output binding policy")
        return alias_layout(model,period,execution_abi=execution_abi)
    checked=validate(model)
    return declarations(model["inputs"],[dict(name=o["name"],shape=checked["shapes"][o["value"]])
                                       for o in model["outputs"]],period,graph_resource_profile(model),execution_abi)

def validate_layout(value):
    require(type(value) is dict and value.get("execution_abi") in ABIS,"Capacity layout identity")
    profile=value.get("resource_profile",{})
    require(type(profile) is dict and type(profile.get("name")) is str and
            profile==identity(profile["name"]),"Changed capacity resource profile")
    require(type(value.get("outputs")) is list and all(type(o) is dict and {"name","shape"}<=set(o)
            for o in value["outputs"]),"Capacity output declarations")
    if "output_binding" in value:
        from unified_output_aliases import validate_layout as validate_alias_layout
        return validate_alias_layout(value)
    expected=declarations(value.get("logical_inputs"),[dict(name=o["name"],shape=o["shape"])
        for o in value["outputs"]],value.get("input_slot_period"),profile["name"],value["execution_abi"])
    require(canonical(value)==canonical(expected),"Changed capacity physical layout")
    return expected["input_slot_period"]

def rules(value):
    extra=""
    if "output_binding" in value:
        from unified_output_aliases import rules as alias_rules
        extra=alias_rules(value)
    p=value["resource_profile"]
    if value["execution_abi"] in EXTENDED_ABIS:
        validate_layout(value)
        text="""
Capacity ABI unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v3: resource_profile and physical bindings are immutable.
Only resnet20-v1 uses this ABI. At most sixteen input chunks and sixteen output chunks;
append exactly one trusted encrypted zero_ct to the ordered x0,x1,... entry parameters.
Logical tensors retain their declared shapes and names. Flatten each separately in C order,
partition into P-element chunks, pad each final chunk, and repeat each chunk across 16384 slots.
Return all physical ciphertexts in the frozen output order; selectors decode only logical elements.
Every logical operation must include all chunks, including tails. A chunk rotation is not a
whole-tensor rotation. Reductions exclude padded slots, including padding changed by public bias.
Native helpers retain sixteen parameters and object storage retains sixteen cells.
Source, AST, work, sandbox, depth, rotations and security limits remain unchanged.
"""+"Logical input/output element limits: "+str(p["input_elements"])+"/"+str(p["output_elements"])+".\n"
        if p["name"]=="general-tensors-v1":
            text=text.replace("Only resnet20-v1 uses this ABI.", "This request selects the general-tensors-v1 profile (logical rank 1..32).")
            text+="Individual operators retain their registered rank and axis restrictions. Object-array construction bounds remain unchanged.\n"
            text+="Static transpose/permute use the tensor_route masks from the frozen packing descriptor; they route logical C-order elements across chunks.\n"
        if value["execution_abi"]==WIDE_ABI:
            text=text.replace(EXTENDED_ABI,WIDE_ABI)
            text+="V4 uses an explicitly bound P in 512/1024/2048/4096; no other ABI permits these periods.\n"
            text+="For slice, tensor_route masks map static C-order source elements to the declared output, including cross-chunk boundaries.\n"
        return text+extra
    return """
Capacity ABI unified-capacity-chunked-inputs-v2: resource_profile is immutable.
The logical graph uses its declared resource profile; physical chunk bindings,
periods, rotations, four input/output ciphertexts and encrypted-zero rules remain fixed.
Every logical operation includes all chunks and C-order elements, including tail chunks.
A rotation of one chunk is not a rotation of the whole tensor. Reductions must exclude
padded tail slots, including padding made nonzero by public additions.
A larger logical graph does not relax source, work, sandbox, depth or security bounds.
"""+"Logical input/output element limits: "+str(p["input_elements"])+"/"+str(p["output_elements"])+".\n"+extra

def tail_masks(model,period):
    checked=validate(model)
    lengths={math.prod(shape)%period for name,shape in checked["shapes"].items()
             if checked["kinds"][name]=="cipher" and math.prod(shape)%period}
    return {"tail"+str(n):[float(i<n) for i in range(period)] for n in sorted(lengths)}

def period_rotations(period,value):
    """Authorize a wide rotation set only after checking every physical binding."""
    validate_layout(value)
    require(value["execution_abi"]==WIDE_ABI and type(period) is int and
            period==value["input_slot_period"],"Wide period/layout binding mismatch")
    return tuple(1<<i for i in range(period.bit_length()-1))

"""Independent logical model/layout preparation for the opt-in unified graph ABI."""
import math
from unified_output_aliases import policy as output_policy
from benchmark_graph import FORMAT, canonical, digest, require, validate

ABI="unified-periodic-inputs-v1"
TASK="hecate-unified-graph-synthesis-v1"
CONTRACT="hecate-unified-native-v1"
GOLDEN_WORK_LIMIT=1024
COMPACT="compact-periodic-v1"
LEGACY_ORIGINS={"kind":"verified public model and layout"}
COMPACT_ORIGINS={**LEGACY_ORIGINS,"policy":COMPACT,
    "packing_masks":"mask0 selects slot zero. A replicated ciphertext value can be multiplied by mask0 and then rotated to the desired output slot using permitted rotations."}
GUIDANCE={"schema":1,"model":"logical tensor graph","packing":"common periodic inputs, named packed outputs",
          "linear":"cross-element weighted reduction","array_cells":"whole Exprs, never slots",
          "scope":"bounded native construction, no unrestricted Python"}
RULES="""Implement the supplied logical graph exactly, including every named output.
Only @hc.func("c,p,...") decorated functions: golden plus at most 16 scalar-Expr helpers.
Golden parameters must match layout.inputs in order, followed by zero_ct; all are c.
Every logical input is encrypted separately: C-order flatten, pad to P, repeat across
16384 slots. P=layout.input_slot_period. Never concatenate logical inputs before encryption.
Return one ciphertext per named output in layout.outputs order, with logical values in
its C-order prefix, repeated every P slots. Other slots are unobserved.
Arithmetic +,-,*, unary minus requires a ciphertext operand. Public constants are immutable
scalar or length-P values in public_constants; finite literals with magnitude<=1024 allowed.
Positive rotate(k) reads slot j+k; only positive powers of two below P are callable.
Compose rotations for other displacements. Linear is a reduction, not elementwise multiply.
zero_ct is client-encrypted zero, not an extra model input or a bootstrap substitute.
Compiler owns security, scale, level, rescale, modswitch and relinearization.
Helpers have typed scalar c/p positional parameters, no recursion, defaults, kwargs or imports.
Public bounded range loops, assignments, tuple/list unpacking and final returns are permitted.
np.array(data,dtype=object), literal indexing/slicing, reshape/flatten/copy/transpose/T/item
operate on whole Expr storage: rank<=4, cells<=16, never ciphertext slots.
Array-left +,-,* uses outer-storage broadcasting. Scalar +=,-=,*= rebind; array name-target
augmentation mutates shared storage, copies remain independent. No subscript writes.
Starred calls expand the first axis into scalar Expr arguments. No encrypted conditions,
while, arbitrary calls, I/O, network, bootstrap, raw level changes or hidden data access.
Expanded work<=4096, golden work<=1024, source<=65536 bytes, AST and sandbox bounds apply.
Do not change weights, layout, reference, numerical thresholds or test inputs.
Return only response-schema JSON. Numerical correctness requires real encrypted validation.
"""


def layout(model,chunk_period=None,*,capacity_abi=None,output_binding_policy=None):
    from benchmark_graph import CAPACITY_FORMAT
    if model.get("format")==CAPACITY_FORMAT:
        from unified_capacity_layout import layout as capacity_layout
        return capacity_layout(model,chunk_period,execution_abi=capacity_abi,output_binding_policy=output_binding_policy)
    require(output_binding_policy is None,"Output binding policy requires capacity graph")
    require(capacity_abi is None,"Capacity ABI requires capacity graph")
    if chunk_period is not None:
        from unified_chunk_layout import layout as chunk_layout
        return chunk_layout(model,chunk_period)
    check=validate(model)
    sizes=[math.prod(s["shape"]) for s in model["inputs"]]+[
        math.prod(s) for s in check["output_shapes"].values()]
    period=next(p for p in (4,8,16,32,64,128,256) if p>=max(sizes))
    inputs=[dict(name=s["name"],dsl_name=("x","y","z","t")[i],shape=s["shape"])
            for i,s in enumerate(model["inputs"])]
    outputs=[dict(name=o["name"],shape=check["shapes"][o["value"]],ciphertext=i)
             for i,o in enumerate(model["outputs"])]
    selectors=[[i,j] for i,o in enumerate(outputs) for j in range(math.prod(o["shape"]))]
    return dict(execution_abi=ABI,input_slot_period=period,inputs=inputs,outputs=outputs,
                output_ciphertexts=len(outputs),output_selectors=selectors,
                output_shape=[len(selectors)],output_representation="named_packed_prefixes",
                auxiliary_ciphertexts=[dict(dsl_name="zero_ct",kind="encrypted_zero",source="trusted_client",
                                             slot_period=period)])


def validate_layout(value):
    from unified_capacity_layout import ABIS as CAPACITY_ABIS,validate_layout as validate_capacity
    if type(value) is dict and value.get("execution_abi") in CAPACITY_ABIS:return validate_capacity(value)
    from unified_chunk_layout import ABI as CHUNK_ABI,validate_layout as validate_chunk
    if type(value) is dict and value.get("execution_abi")==CHUNK_ABI:return validate_chunk(value)
    require(type(value) is dict and value.get("execution_abi")==ABI,"Unified layout identity")
    require(set(value)=={"execution_abi","input_slot_period","inputs","outputs","output_ciphertexts",
                         "output_selectors","output_shape","output_representation","auxiliary_ciphertexts"},
            "Unified layout fields")
    # Reconstruct only logical declarations, then compare every derived field.
    specs=value["inputs"];outputs=value["outputs"]
    require(type(specs) is list and 1<=len(specs)<=4 and type(outputs) is list and 1<=len(outputs)<=4,
            "Unified ABI arity")
    from benchmark_graph import dimensions,NAME
    require(all(type(s) is dict and set(s)=={"name","dsl_name","shape"} and
                type(s["name"]) is str and NAME.fullmatch(s["name"]) and
                s["dsl_name"]==("x","y","z","t")[i] for i,s in enumerate(specs)),"Unified input binding")
    require(len({s["name"] for s in specs})==len(specs),"Repeated input")
    shapes=[dimensions(s["shape"]) for s in specs]
    require(sum(math.prod(s) for s in shapes)<=256,"Unified input budget")
    require(all(type(o) is dict and set(o)=={"name","shape","ciphertext"} and
                type(o["name"]) is str and NAME.fullmatch(o["name"]) and type(o["ciphertext"]) is int and
                o["ciphertext"]==i for i,o in enumerate(outputs)),"Unified output binding")
    require(len({o["name"] for o in outputs})==len(outputs),"Repeated output")
    outs=[dimensions(o["shape"]) for o in outputs]
    require(sum(math.prod(s) for s in outs)<=256,"Unified output budget")
    p=next(p for p in (4,8,16,32,64,128,256) if p>=max(math.prod(s) for s in shapes+outs))
    selectors=[[i,j] for i,s in enumerate(outs) for j in range(math.prod(s))]
    require(canonical(value)==canonical(dict(execution_abi=ABI,input_slot_period=p,inputs=specs,outputs=outputs,
        output_ciphertexts=len(outs),output_selectors=selectors,output_shape=[len(selectors)],
        output_representation="named_packed_prefixes",
        auxiliary_ciphertexts=[dict(dsl_name="zero_ct",kind="encrypted_zero",source="trusted_client",slot_period=p)])),
        "Changed unified physical layout")
    return p


def scalars(value):
    if type(value) is list:
        return [v for child in value for v in scalars(child)]
    return [float(value)]


def registry(model,plan,policy=None,capacity_packing_version=None):
    """Public constant preparation is independent of rule-emitted DSL."""
    require(policy in (None,COMPACT),"Unknown unified constant policy")
    check=validate(model)
    numbers={0.0,1.0,-1.0,2.0,-2.0,0.5}
    from unified_capacity_layout import ABIS as CAPACITY_ABIS
    packed=None
    if plan["execution_abi"] in CAPACITY_ABIS:
        from unified_capacity_constants import packing,VERSION
        packed=packing(model,plan,capacity_packing_version or VERSION)
    for name,value in model["constants"].items():
        if packed is None or name not in packed["excluded_scalars"]:numbers.update(scalars(value))
    for node in model["nodes"]:
        op=node["op"];refs=node["inputs"];a=node["attrs"]
        if op=="mean":
            shape=check["shapes"][refs[0]]
            numbers.add(1.0/math.prod(shape[i%len(shape)] for i in a["axes"]))
        if op in ("avg_pool1d","avg_pool2d"):
            import itertools
            rank=1 if op.endswith("1d") else 2
            spatial=check["shapes"][refs[0]][-rank:]
            output=check["shapes"][node["outputs"][0]][-rank:]
            if a["count_include_pad"]:numbers.add(1.0/math.prod(a["kernel"]))
            else:
                for pos in itertools.product(*(range(n) for n in output)):
                    valid=math.prod(max(0,min(n,p*st-pad+k)-max(0,p*st-pad))
                                    for n,p,st,pad,k in zip(spatial,pos,a["stride"],a["padding"],a["kernel"]))
                    require(valid>0,"Empty average window")
                    numbers.add(1.0/valid)
        if op=="batch_norm":
            if packed is not None and packed["tensor_strategies"].get(node["id"])=="channel_affine":continue
            mean,var,gamma,beta=[model["constants"][r] for r in refs[1:]]
            for m,v,g,b in zip(mean,var,gamma,beta):
                gain=g/math.sqrt(v+a["eps"]);numbers.update((gain,b-m*gain))
    require(all(math.isfinite(v) and abs(v)<=1024 for v in numbers),"Derived public constant magnitude")
    values={"p"+str(i):v for i,v in enumerate(sorted(numbers))}
    max_output=max(math.prod(o["shape"]) for o in plan["outputs"])
    from unified_chunk_layout import ABI as CHUNK_ABI
    from unified_capacity_layout import ABIS as CAPACITY_ABIS
    if plan["execution_abi"] in (CHUNK_ABI,*CAPACITY_ABIS):max_output=min(max_output,plan["input_slot_period"])
    p=plan["input_slot_period"]
    for i in range(1 if policy==COMPACT else max(1,max_output)):values["mask"+str(i)]=[float(j==i) for j in range(p)]
    if plan["execution_abi"] in CAPACITY_ABIS:
        from unified_capacity_layout import tail_masks
        values.update(tail_masks(model,p))
    if packed is not None:values.update(packed["vectors"])
    require(len(values)<=256,"Unified constant registry budget")
    return values


def prepare(model,profile_hash,configuration=None,construction=None,*,construction_profile=None,constant_policy=None,helper_profile=None,helper_exercise=None,chunk_period=None,generation_guidance=None,capability_composition=None,capacity_packing_version=None,capacity_abi=None,public_weight_policy=None,output_binding_policy=None):

        from capability_combinations import validate_selection
        validate_selection(capability_composition,construction_profile,construction,helper_profile,helper_exercise,chunk_period)
    p=layout(model,chunk_period,capacity_abi=capacity_abi,output_binding_policy=output_binding_policy)
    from unified_capacity_layout import ABIS as CAPACITY_ABIS

    require((helper_profile!=CHUNK_PROFILE and (chunk_period is None or helper_profile is None))
            or (helper_profile==CHUNK_PROFILE and chunk_period is not None),
            "Chunk layout requires separately verified upstream helper bindings")
    try:
        constants=registry(model,p,constant_policy,capacity_packing_version)

        if constant_policy is not None or str(error)!="Unified constant registry budget":raise
        constant_policy=COMPACT
        constants=registry(model,p,constant_policy,capacity_packing_version)
    body=dict(schema=1,task=TASK,model=model,fx_graph="independent typed logical DAG; no rule DSL included",
              public_constants=constants,constant_origins=dict(COMPACT_ORIGINS if constant_policy==COMPACT else LEGACY_ORIGINS),
              layout=p,rules=RULES,response_schema=RESPONSE_SCHEMA,semantic_guidance=GUIDANCE,
              compiler_profile_sha256=profile_hash,privacy={"input":"encrypted","weights":"public"})
    if capacity:
        from unified_capacity_constants import packing,VERSION
        descriptor=packing(model,p,capacity_packing_version or VERSION)["descriptor"]

    if helper_profile is not None:
        from upstream_candidate_helpers import PROFILE,BN_PROFILE,CONCAT_PROFILE,SPATIAL_PROFILE,MAPPED_PROFILE,FUSED_PROFILE,DS_PROFILE,VR_PROFILE,CHUNK_PROFILE,POLYNOMIAL_PROFILE,POLYNOMIAL_RULES,manifest,RULES as HELPER_RULES,BN_RULES,CONCAT_RULES,SPATIAL_RULES,MAPPED_RULES,FUSED_RULES,DS_RULES,VR_RULES,CHUNK_RULES
        require(helper_profile in (PROFILE,BN_PROFILE,CONCAT_PROFILE,SPATIAL_PROFILE,MAPPED_PROFILE,FUSED_PROFILE,DS_PROFILE,VR_PROFILE,CHUNK_PROFILE,POLYNOMIAL_PROFILE) and construction_profile is None and (construction is None or capability_composition is not None),
                "Upstream helpers currently require free native construction")
        body["upstream_helpers"]=manifest(model,helper_profile,chunk_period,backend="poseidon_cpu" if configuration and configuration.get("backend")=="poseidon_cpu" else None)
        body["rules"]+=POLYNOMIAL_RULES if helper_profile==POLYNOMIAL_PROFILE else CHUNK_RULES if helper_profile==CHUNK_PROFILE else VR_RULES if helper_profile==VR_PROFILE else DS_RULES if helper_profile==DS_PROFILE else FUSED_RULES if helper_profile==FUSED_PROFILE else MAPPED_RULES if helper_profile==MAPPED_PROFILE else SPATIAL_RULES if helper_profile==SPATIAL_PROFILE else HELPER_RULES if helper_profile==PROFILE else CONCAT_RULES if helper_profile==CONCAT_PROFILE else BN_RULES

        body['rules']+=WITNESS_RULES
    if construction_profile is not None:
        from unified_public_contract import CONTRACT as PUBLIC,RULES as PUBLIC_RULES,GUIDANCE as PUBLIC_GUIDANCE
        require(construction_profile==PUBLIC,"Unknown unified construction profile")

    if capability_composition is not None:

        body["capability_composition"]=capability_composition
        body["rules"]+=COMPOSITION_RULES

        from unified_capacity_layout import rules as capacity_rules
        from unified_capacity_constants import rules as public_tensor_rules,VERSION

def static_repair_hint(source,request,diagnostic=""):
    """Bounded AST observations with fixed messages, never execution or source echo."""
    import ast
    if "generation_guidance" not in request:
        return ""
    validate_request(request)
    if type(source) is not str or len(source.encode())>65536:
        return ""
    try:
        tree=ast.parse(source)
    except (SyntaxError,ValueError,RecursionError):
        return ""
    if sum(1 for _ in ast.walk(tree))>4096:
        return ""
    guidance=explicit_generation_guidance(request,request["generation_guidance"]["version"])
    entry=[n for n in tree.body if type(n) is ast.FunctionDef and n.name=="golden"]
    hints=[]
    if len(entry)!=1:
        hints.append("Define exactly one top-level function named golden; main is not the entry point. Required header: "+guidance["entry_header"])
    else:
        fn=entry[0]
        expected=ast.parse(guidance["entry_header"]+"\n    pass").body[0]
        if ([ast.dump(d) for d in fn.decorator_list]!=
                [ast.dump(d) for d in expected.decorator_list]):
            hints.append("The golden decorator must be a literal hc.func call, not a bare attribute. Required header: "+guidance["entry_header"])
        if (ast.dump(fn.args)!=ast.dump(expected.args) or fn.returns is not None):
            hints.append("Golden parameters must be the exact unannotated positional ABI. Required header: "+guidance["entry_header"])
    if any(type(n) is ast.Call and type(n.func) is ast.Attribute and
           type(n.func.value) is ast.Name and n.func.value.id=="hc" and n.func.attr=="rotate"
           for n in ast.walk(tree)):
        hints.append(guidance["rotation_rule"])
    if "construction_profile" in request and any(
            type(n) is ast.FunctionDef and n.name!="golden" and n.decorator_list
            for n in ast.walk(tree)):
        hints.append(guidance["helper_rule"])
    for item in guidance.get("construction_requirements",[]):
        hints.append(item["feature"]+": "+item["instruction"])
    if guidance["version"]==TYPED_GUIDANCE:
        from unified_failure_semantics import repair_hint
        hint=repair_hint(diagnostic)
        if hint:hints.append(hint)
    if guidance["version"] in (BINDING_GUIDANCE,PRECISE_GUIDANCE,GATE_GUIDANCE,EXPRESSION_GUIDANCE,POSEIDON_GUIDANCE,BINDING_CONTEXT_GUIDANCE,TENSOR_AXIS_GUIDANCE,CONSTRUCTION_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_BINDING_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_ALIAS_GUIDANCE):
        from unified_typed_guidance import repair_hint
        hint=repair_hint(request,diagnostic)
        if hint:hints.append(hint)
    if guidance["version"] in (PRECISE_GUIDANCE,GATE_GUIDANCE,EXPRESSION_GUIDANCE,POSEIDON_GUIDANCE,BINDING_CONTEXT_GUIDANCE,TENSOR_AXIS_GUIDANCE,CONSTRUCTION_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_BINDING_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_ALIAS_GUIDANCE):
        from unified_precise_guidance import repair_hint
        hint=repair_hint(request,diagnostic)
        if hint:hints.append(hint)
    if guidance["version"] in (EXPRESSION_GUIDANCE,POSEIDON_GUIDANCE,BINDING_CONTEXT_GUIDANCE,TENSOR_AXIS_GUIDANCE,CONSTRUCTION_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_BINDING_GUIDANCE,OUTPUT_ALIAS_GUIDANCE):
        if guidance["version"]==OUTPUT_ALIAS_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_output_alias_guidance import repair_hint
        elif guidance["version"]==OUTPUT_BINDING_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_output_binding_guidance import repair_hint
        elif guidance["version"]==CONSTRUCTION_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_construction_guidance import repair_hint
        elif guidance["version"]==TENSOR_AXIS_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_tensor_axis_guidance import repair_hint
        elif guidance["version"]==BINDING_CONTEXT_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_binding_guidance import repair_hint
        elif guidance["version"]==POSEIDON_GUIDANCE:
            from unified_poseidon_guidance import repair_hint
        else:
            from unified_expression_guidance import repair_hint
        hint=repair_hint(request,source,diagnostic)
        if hint:hints.append(hint)
    return "\n".join(hints)

def failure(layer, diagnostic):
    """Conservative routing: absence of a bounded witness is not proof of no influence."""
    if type(diagnostic) is dict and diagnostic.get("format") == "poseidon-diagnostic-v2":
        from application_diagnostics import checked
        # Frozen integrity rejection takes priority over a stale attempt hint.
        if layer != "integrity" or diagnostic.get("layer") == "integrity":
            value = checked(diagnostic)
            require(value["layer"] == layer, "Structured diagnostic layer mismatch")
            return value
    if layer == "static_check" and isinstance(diagnostic, CandidateCheckError):
        from application_diagnostics import make
        return make(diagnostic.reason,location=diagnostic.location,context=diagnostic.context)
    text = str(diagnostic)
    evidence = getattr(diagnostic, "evidence", None)
    if layer == "static_check" and evidence and evidence["reason"] == "not_executed":
        code, owner, retry = "required_construct_not_executed", "candidate", "repair_within_budget"
    elif layer == "static_check" and ("Missing contributing" in text or "influence work bound" in text):
        code, owner, retry = "construction_evidence_unresolved", "coverage_checker_or_candidate", "review"
    elif layer == "static_check":
        code, owner, retry = "candidate_contract_rejected", "candidate", "repair_within_budget"
    elif layer == "numerical_comparison":
        code, owner, retry = "numerical_mismatch", "candidate_or_backend", "diagnose"
    elif layer in ("compiler", "artifact_gate"):
        code, owner, retry = "backend_rejected", "candidate_or_backend", "diagnose"
    elif layer == "integrity":
        code, owner, retry = "integrity_rejected", "host", "never_automatic"
    else:
        code, owner, retry = "pipeline_failure", "host", "review"
    outcome = dict(layer=layer, code=code, owner=owner, retry_policy=retry, diagnostic=text[:2000])
    if evidence is not None:outcome["construction_evidence"] = evidence
    return outcome

def validate_program(candidate, request):
    """Static legality and directed evidence are reported independently; neither proves FHE."""
    validate_request(request)
    outcome = dict(format=VERSION, request_id=request["request_id"], status="rejected",
                   semantic_validation="not_checked", construction_coverage="not_requested",
                   encrypted_execution=False, numerically_validated=False, paid_calls=0)
    try:
        validate_candidate(candidate, request, check_construction=False)
        outcome["semantic_validation"] = "accepted"
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError) as error:
        outcome["failure"] = failure("static_check", error)
        return outcome
    directed = "construction_exercise" in request or "upstream_exercise" in request
    if directed:
        try:
            validate_candidate(candidate, request)
            outcome["construction_coverage"] = "static_witness_obtained"
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError) as error:
            outcome["construction_coverage"] = "not_verified"
            outcome["failure"] = failure("static_check", error)
            return outcome
    outcome["status"] = "static_accepted_not_executed"
    return outcome

def synthesize(request, provider, evaluator, record, *, max_repairs=3, validation_level="numerical", control=None):
    """Trusted injected capabilities, with the existing bounded loop; no plugin loading."""
    from candidate_contract import run_feedback_loop
    from public_feedback_contract import public_feedback
    validate_request(request)
    require(validation_level in ("compiled", "numerical"), "Explicit validation level")
    def checked_evaluate(raw, index):
        result = evaluator(raw, index)
        if result.get("status") == "passed":
            if validation_level == "numerical":
                require(result.get("encrypted_execution") is True and result.get("numerically_validated") is True,
                        "Component success requires encrypted numerical validation")
            else:
                require(result.get("compiled_validated") is True and result.get("validation_level") == "compiled",
                        "Component compiled success requires audited artifacts")
            return dict(status="passed", layer="complete")
        # Qualification reports contain private local evidence paths. Never forward
        # them, arbitrary diagnostic text, or reference arrays to the provider.
        if control is not None:
            control.observe_failure(result)
        feedback = result.get("public_feedback")
        if feedback is None:
            feedback = dict(status="failed", layer="component", category="infrastructure",
                            diagnostic="Qualification failed without approved public feedback")
        return public_feedback(feedback)
    return run_feedback_loop(copy.deepcopy(request), provider, checked_evaluate, record, max_repairs, control=control)

class MixedEmitter(scalar_rule.ReplicatedEmitter):
    """Literal authority is the existing public-origin rule, reconstructed lazily."""
    def __init__(self, request, checked):
        super().__init__(request, {})
        self.checked = checked
        self.authority_loaded = False
        self.capacity_inline_rotations = True
        self.capacity_helpers = {}
        self.emitted_statement_bytes = 0

    def emit(self, text, zero=False):
        result = super().emit(text, zero)
        self.emitted_statement_bytes += len(self.lines[-1].encode())+1
        require(self.emitted_statement_bytes <= 65536, "Mixed emitted statement source budget")
        return result

    def literal(self, value):
        key = exact(float(value))
        if key not in self.scalar_names and not self.authority_loaded:
            self.allowed = scalar_rule.literal_sources(self.request["model"], self.checked)
            self.authority_loaded = True
        return super().literal(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PackedStorage:
    key: int
    parts: tuple
    elements: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BoundCell:
    storage: PackedStorage
    index: int


class TensorValue:
    """A logical ndarray of immutable BoundCell or replicated Scalar references."""
    def __init__(self, entries):
        self.entries = np.asarray(entries, dtype=object)
        require(all(isinstance(v, (BoundCell, Scalar)) for v in self.entries.flat),
                "Mixed value must retain cipher logical references")
        self.entries.setflags(write=False)
        self.shape = tuple(self.entries.shape)

    def canonical_storage(self):
        flat = self.entries.reshape(-1)
        if not flat.size or not isinstance(flat[0], BoundCell):
            return None
        storage = flat[0].storage
        if storage.elements != flat.size:
            return None
        if not all(isinstance(ref, BoundCell) and ref.storage is storage and ref.index == i
                   for i, ref in enumerate(flat)):
            return None
        return storage


class Materializer:
    """Emitter-local immutable index maps, exact cell cache and pack boundaries."""
    def __init__(self, emitter):
        self.em = emitter
        self.storages = []
        self.storage_objects = []
        self.cells = {}
        self.pack_cache = {}
        self.materializations = []
        self.packs = []
        p = emitter.period
        require(type(p) is int and p > 0 and p & (p-1) == 0, "Mixed power-of-two period")
        require(emitter.request["public_constants"].get("mask0") == [1.]+[0.]*(p-1),
                "Mixed bound mask0 must be full-period one-hot")

    def packed_value(self, parts, shape, *, producer):
        size = math.prod(shape)
        require(size > 0 and len(parts) == math.ceil(size/self.em.period), "Mixed canonical chunk count")
        require(all(isinstance(part, Scalar) and part.e is self.em for part in parts), "Mixed foreign emitter")
        storage = PackedStorage(len(self.storages), tuple(parts), size)
        self.storages.append(dict(storage=storage.key, producer=copy.deepcopy(producer), shape=list(shape),
                                 elements=size, parts=[part.name for part in parts]))
        self.storage_objects.append(storage)
        refs = np.empty(size, dtype=object)
        for index in range(size):
            refs[index] = BoundCell(storage, index)
        return TensorValue(refs.reshape(shape))

    def cell(self, ref):
        if isinstance(ref, Scalar):
            require(ref.e is self.em, "Mixed foreign replicated cell")
            return ref
        require(isinstance(ref, BoundCell) and type(ref.index) is int and
                0 <= ref.index < ref.storage.elements, "Mixed invalid logical cell")
        require(type(ref.storage.key) is int and 0 <= ref.storage.key < len(self.storage_objects)
                and self.storage_objects[ref.storage.key] is ref.storage, "Mixed foreign packed storage")
        chunk, slot = divmod(ref.index, self.em.period)
        original = ref.storage.parts[chunk]
        require(isinstance(original, Scalar) and original.e is self.em, "Mixed foreign packed expression")
        key = (original.name, slot, self.em.period)
        if key in self.cells:
            return self.cells[key]
        mask = "mask"+str(slot)
        if mask in self.em.request["public_constants"]:
            require(self.em.request["public_constants"][mask] ==
                    [float(i == slot) for i in range(self.em.period)], "Mixed bound cell mask is not one-hot")
            masked = self.em.zero if original.zero else self.em.emit(original.name+" * "+mask)
            route = "bound_slot_mask"
        else:
            masked = self.em.zero if original.zero else self.em.emit(self.em.rotate(original, slot).name+" * mask0")
            mask, route = "mask0", "bound_mask0_rotated_source"
        value = masked
        if not value.zero:
            for bit in range(self.em.period.bit_length()-1):
                value = value+self.em.rotate(value, 1 << bit)
        self.cells[key] = value
        self.materializations.append(dict(storage=ref.storage.key, logical_index=ref.index, chunk=chunk,
            slot=slot, source=original.name, mask=mask, route=route, replicated_expression=value.name))
        return value

    def array(self, value):
        if not isinstance(value, TensorValue):
            return value
        result = np.empty(value.shape, dtype=object)
        for index in np.ndindex(value.shape):
            result[index] = self.cell(value.entries[index])
        return result

    def chunks(self, value, *, boundary):
        require(isinstance(value, TensorValue), "Mixed packing requires cipher value")
        storage = value.canonical_storage()
        if storage is not None:
            require(type(storage.key) is int and 0 <= storage.key < len(self.storage_objects)
                    and self.storage_objects[storage.key] is storage, "Mixed foreign canonical storage")
            return Chunks(self.em, storage.parts, value.shape)
        array = self.array(value).reshape(-1)
        key = tuple((item.name, item.zero) for item in array)
        if key not in self.pack_cache:
            parts = tuple(self.em.pack(array[i:i+self.em.period]) for i in range(0, array.size, self.em.period))
            self.pack_cache[key] = parts
            self.packs.append(dict(boundary=copy.deepcopy(boundary), shape=list(value.shape),
                elements=array.size, cell_expressions=[v.name for v in array], parts=[v.name for v in parts],
                packing="canonical_C_order_prefixes"))
        return Chunks(self.em, self.pack_cache[key], value.shape)

    def index_map(self, value):
        if not isinstance(value, TensorValue):
            return None
        result = []
        for ref in value.entries.flat:
            if isinstance(ref, BoundCell):
                result.append(["packed", ref.storage.key, ref.index])
            else:
                result.append(["replicated_cell", ref.name, ref.zero])
        return dict(shape=list(value.shape), binding=digest(result))


def view(op, xs, attrs):
    """Shape/index transformations emit no cipher arithmetic."""
    entries = [x.entries if isinstance(x, TensorValue) else x for x in xs]
    x = entries[0]
    if op == "reshape": result = x.reshape(attrs["shape"])
    elif op == "flatten": result = x.reshape(-1)
    elif op == "transpose": result = np.swapaxes(x, attrs["dim0"], attrs["dim1"])
    elif op == "permute": result = x.transpose(attrs["dims"])
    elif op == "rotate": result = np.roll(x.reshape(-1), -attrs["step"]).reshape(x.shape)
    elif op == "concat": result = np.concatenate(entries, axis=attrs["axis"])
    elif op == "stack": result = np.stack(entries, axis=attrs["axis"])
    elif op == "slice":
        index = [slice(None)]*x.ndim
        index[attrs["axis"]] = slice(attrs["start"], attrs["stop"], attrs["step"])
        result = x[tuple(index)]
    elif op == "split": result = np.split(x, np.cumsum(attrs["sections"])[:-1], axis=attrs["axis"])
    else: raise ValueError("Unsupported mixed view "+op)
    is_cipher = any(isinstance(value, TensorValue) for value in xs)
    if is_cipher:
        return [TensorValue(item) for item in result] if op == "split" else TensorValue(result)
    return result


def packed_binary(op, xs, outshape, node, packed, materializer):
    """Only identical canonical slot coordinates or registered public vectors."""
    em = materializer.em
    require(any(isinstance(value, TensorValue) for value in xs),
            "Mixed arithmetic requires cipher operand; all-public nodes unsupported")
    public = []
    operands = []
    count = math.ceil(math.prod(outshape)/em.period)
    for number, value in enumerate(xs):
        if isinstance(value, TensorValue):
            storage = value.canonical_storage()
            if storage is None or value.shape != tuple(outshape):
                return None
            operands.append(storage.parts)
            public.append(False)
        else:
            try: expanded = np.broadcast_to(value, outshape)
            except ValueError: return None
            if not expanded.size:
                return None
            if np.all(expanded == expanded.reshape(-1)[0]):
                operands.append((float(expanded.reshape(-1)[0]),)*count)
            else:
                # Authority is the original node/operand/chunk binding, never a
                # numeric lookup in opaque pv vectors.
                operands.append(tuple(public_vector(em, packed, node["id"], "elementwise", operand=number, chunk=j)
                                      for j in range(count)))
            public.append(True)
    if all(public):
        return None
    parts = []
    for a, b in zip(*operands):
        if isinstance(a, (Scalar, PublicVector)) and isinstance(b, (Scalar, PublicVector)):
            result = vector_arithmetic(em, op, a, b)
        elif isinstance(a, Scalar):
            result = a+b if op == "add" else a-b if op == "subtract" else a*b
        else:
            result = b+a if op == "add" else a-b if op == "subtract" else b*a
        parts.append(result)
    return materializer.packed_value(parts, outshape, producer=dict(node_id=node["id"], kind="packed_pointwise"))


def unary(op, x, coefficients, attrs, zero):
    if op == "negate": return -x
    if op == "square": return x*x
    if op == "power": return x**attrs["exponent"]
    if attrs["basis"] == "power": return power_polynomial(x, coefficients, zero)
    from chebyshev_lowering import balanced
    return balanced(x, coefficients, zero)


def packing_record(packed):
    """Exact trusted packing schema: only excluded_scalars has set semantics.

    Every other original field is copied unchanged and remains JSON-canonical.
    Unknown fields/types fail closed; no repr/default=str coercion is used.
    This function never alters the packing consumed by the existing emitter.
    """
    fields = {"vectors", "bindings", "excluded_scalars", "linear_strategies", "linear_tiles",
              "tensor_strategies", "stack_operands", "spatial_windows", "spatial_streams",
              "suffix_windows", "descriptor"}
    require(type(packed) is dict and set(packed) == fields, "Mixed exact internal packing schema")
    excluded = packed["excluded_scalars"]
    require(type(excluded) is set and all(type(name) is str for name in excluded),
            "Mixed excluded_scalars must be set[str]")
    payload = {name:(sorted(excluded) if name == "excluded_scalars" else copy.deepcopy(value))
               for name, value in packed.items()}
    result = dict(format=PACKING_FORMAT, packing=payload)
    canonical(result)  # Reject any unexpected nested/non-JSON type or nonfinite value.
    return result

        inputs.append(dict(name=spec["name"], shape=spec["shape"], chunks=copy.deepcopy(bindings),
                           representation="canonical_packed_input"))
    transitions = []
    views = {"reshape", "flatten", "transpose", "permute", "rotate", "concat", "stack", "slice", "split"}
    for node in model["nodes"]:

            require(isinstance(xs[0], TensorValue) and all(ref in model["constants"] for ref in node["inputs"][1:]),
                    "Mixed Linear requires bound original public weight/bias")
            original = materializer.chunks(xs[0], boundary=dict(node_id=node["id"], kind="linear_input"))
            result = original.linear(node, packed, shape)
            y = materializer.packed_value(result.parts, shape, producer=dict(node_id=node["id"], kind="bound_packed_linear"))
            mode = "bound_packed_linear"
        elif op in ("add", "subtract", "multiply"):
            y = packed_binary(op, xs, shape, node, packed, materializer)
            mode = "packed_pointwise"
            if y is None:
                a, b = [materializer.array(x) for x in xs]
                y = TensorValue(a+b if op == "add" else a-b if op == "subtract" else a*b)
                mode = "replicated_cells_math"
        elif op in ("sum", "mean"):
            require(isinstance(xs[0], TensorValue), "Mixed reduction requires cipher tensor")
            a = materializer.array(xs[0])
            axes = tuple(i % a.ndim for i in attrs["axes"])
            result = np.asarray(np.sum(a, axis=axes, keepdims=attrs["keepdims"]), dtype=object)
            if op == "mean": result = np.asarray(result/math.prod(a.shape[i] for i in axes), dtype=object)
            if result.ndim == 0 and shape == [1]: result = result.reshape(1)
            y = TensorValue(result)
            mode = "replicated_cells_reduction"
        else:
            require(isinstance(xs[0], TensorValue), "Mixed unary requires cipher tensor")
            coeff = xs[1] if op == "polynomial" else None
            storage = xs[0].canonical_storage()
            if storage is not None:
                parts = [unary(op, part, coeff, attrs, em.zero) for part in storage.parts]
                y = materializer.packed_value(parts, shape, producer=dict(node_id=node["id"], kind="packed_unary"))
                mode = "packed_pointwise"
            else:
                a = materializer.array(xs[0])
                result = np.empty(a.shape, dtype=object)
                for index in np.ndindex(a.shape):
                    result[index] = unary(op, a[index], coeff, attrs, em.zero)
                y = TensorValue(result)
                mode = "replicated_cells_math"
        children = y if op == "split" else [y]
        require(len(children) == len(node["outputs"]), "Mixed operator output count")
        for name, result in zip(node["outputs"], children):
            require(list(result.shape) == checked["shapes"][name], "Mixed logical shape mismatch")
            values[name] = result
        transitions.append(dict(node_id=node["id"], operator=op, representation=mode,
            outputs={name:materializer.index_map(values[name]) for name in node["outputs"]}))
    outputs, output_bindings = [], []
    from unified_output_aliases import physical_output_items
    for output, binding in physical_output_items(model,q["layout"]):
        value = values[output["value"]]
        require(isinstance(value, TensorValue) and list(value.shape) == binding["shape"], "Mixed output logical shape")
        chunks = materializer.chunks(value, boundary=dict(output_name=output["name"], kind="physical_output"))
        require(len(chunks.parts) == len(binding["chunks"]), "Mixed output chunk count")
        offset = 0
        for part, original in zip(chunks.parts, binding["chunks"]):
            count = min(em.period, math.prod(value.shape)-offset)
            require(original["ciphertext"] == len(outputs) and original["offset"] == offset and original["elements"] == count,
                    "Mixed output immutable canonical coverage")
            outputs.append(part.name)
            output_bindings.append(dict(name=output["name"], **copy.deepcopy(original)))
            offset += count
        require(offset == math.prod(value.shape), "Mixed complete output coverage")
    require(len(outputs) == q["layout"]["output_ciphertexts"], "Mixed physical output ciphertext count")
    names = [b["dsl_name"] for b in q["layout"]["inputs"]]+["zero_ct"]
    raw_source = '@hc.func("'+','.join('c' for _ in names)+'")\ndef golden('+', '.join(names)+'):\n'
    raw_source += '\n'.join(em.lines)+'\n    return ['+', '.join(outputs)+']\n'
    raw_source = '\n'.join(body for _, body in em.capacity_helpers.values())+raw_source
    require(len(raw_source.encode()) <= 65536, "Rule source budget")
    source = capacity_lowering.compact_scalar_source(raw_source)
    output_identity = None
    if capacity_constants.request_version(q) == capacity_constants.INDEX_VERSION:
        from capacity_output_identity import distinct_outputs
        source, output_identity = distinct_outputs(source)
    static = validate_candidate(dict(schema=1, request_id=q["request_id"], hecate_source=source), q)
    fallback = scalar_rule.literal_map(source, em.fallbacks)
    require(all(row["source_locations"] for row in fallback), "Literal source occurrence missing")
    require(digest(request) == before, "Caller request changed")
    record = dict(format=FORMAT, version=VERSION, source_kind=source_kind,
        strategy="canonical_packed_linear_lazy_replicated_cells_C_order_pack",
        request_id=q["request_id"], input_request_sha256=before, restored_request_sha256=digest(q),
        model_sha256=digest(model), public_constants_sha256=digest(q["public_constants"]),
        layout_sha256=digest(q["layout"]), compiler_configuration_sha256=digest(q["compiler_configuration"]),
        public_packing_record_format=PACKING_FORMAT,
        public_packing_sha256=digest(packing_record(packed)), implementation=implementation(),
        candidate_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
        raw_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
        inputs=inputs, outputs=output_bindings, storages=materializer.storages,
        transitions=transitions, materialized_cells=materializer.materializations, packs=materializer.packs,
        expression_names_graph="raw_emitter_SSA", missing_literals=fallback,
        literal_source_map_sha256=digest(fallback), public_origin_authority_loaded=em.authority_loaded,
        emitted_operations=len(em.lines), emitted_statement_bytes=em.emitted_statement_bytes,
        operations=scalar_rule.source_statistics(source),
        expanded_native_work=static["functions"]["golden"]["expanded_cost"], output_identity=output_identity,
        physical_input_chunks=len(q["layout"]["inputs"]), physical_output_chunks=len(outputs),
        supported_operators=sorted(supported), request_changed=False, model_changed=False,
        public_registry_changed=False, compiler_profile_changed=False, reference_changed=False,
        provider_candidate_rewritten=False, new_agent_generation=False, compiler_run=False,
        encrypted_execution=False, depth_is_capacity_proof=False, peak_allocation_is_known=False)
    record["binding"] = digest(record)
    return source, record

        report["loop"] = run_feedback_loop(request, provider, evaluate, record, max_repairs=args.max_repairs, control=feedback_control)

    except (KeyboardInterrupt, QualificationCancelled):

        return 130
    except Exception as error:
        category = "input" if phase in ("model_description", "model_reference", "fx_translation", "response_input") else "infrastructure"
        report.update(status=category + "_failed", failure_layer=phase, diagnostic=str(error))

    finally:
        update_provider_report(report, provider)
        report["frozen_hashes"] = frozen
        dump(result / "report.json", report)
        print_outcome(report)
        # Native execution is finished and durable numerical evidence is saved.
        # No intermediate/random key material needs to survive the experiment.
        if (result / 'private-keys').exists():

            try:

                print(f"Key cleanup: {cleaned['bytes']} bytes", flush=True)
            except (OSError, ValueError) as error:

"""Trusted validation adapter shared by CLI and component qualification.

The context is private host state; never put it in a provider request.
No provider, credentials or paid transport is constructed by this module.

import ast

from pathlib import Path

class CompilationAccepted(Exception):
    """Internal control flow; cannot originate in a candidate process."""

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ValidationContext:
    result: Path
    request: dict
    report: dict
    frozen: dict
    fixed: dict
    waterline: int
    keys: Path
    unified: bool
    native_run: Callable
    verify_frozen: Callable
    validation_level: str = "numerical"

class CandidateValidationAdapter:
    def __init__(self, context):
        if not isinstance(context, ValidationContext):
            raise TypeError("ValidationContext required")
        require(context.validation_level in ("numerical", "compiled"), "Validation level")
        self.context = context

    def evaluate(self, raw, index):
        import numpy as np
        context = self.context
        result, request, report = context.result, context.request, context.report
        frozen, fixed, waterline = context.frozen, context.fixed, context.waterline
        keys, unified = context.keys, context.unified
        native_run, verify_frozen = context.native_run, context.verify_frozen
        def read_json(path):
            from candidate_contract import MAX_BYTES
            require(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size <= MAX_BYTES, "JSON file size limit")
            return strict_json(path.read_text())
        item = dict(index=index, status="failed", parsed=False, source_parsed=False, checked=False, compiled=False,
                    executed=False, numerically_correct=False)
        report["attempts"].append(item)
        attempt = result / f"attempt-{index:02d}"
        attempt.mkdir()
        output = attempt / "output"
        output.mkdir()
        stage = "response_parse"
        artifact_hashes = {}
        try:
            verify_frozen()
            candidate = strict_json(raw)
            item["parsed"] = True
            stage = "source_parse"
            require(type(candidate) is dict and type(candidate.get("hecate_source")) is str,
                    "Missing Hecate source string")
            require(len(candidate["hecate_source"].encode()) <= 65536, "Source size limit")
            ast.parse(candidate["hecate_source"])
            item["source_parsed"] = True
            stage = "static_check"
            item["static_check"] = validate_candidate(candidate, request)
            item["checked"] = True
            trace_payload = attempt / "trace-payload.json"
            trace_payload.write_text(trace_payload_json(request, candidate))
            frozen[str(trace_payload.relative_to(result))] = digest(trace_payload)
            (attempt / "candidate.py").write_text(candidate["hecate_source"])
            stage = "dsl_trace"
            code = native_run(trace_payload, output, [str(VENV / "bin/python"), "/app/candidate_trace.py"],
                               attempt / "trace.log")
            require(code == 0, f"Isolated Hecate tracing failed (exit {code}); see trace.log")
            item["trace"] = read_json(output / "trace-evidence.json")
            if "upstream_helpers" in request:
                from upstream_candidate_helpers import verify_events
                item['upstream_helper_trace']=verify_events(read_json(output/'upstream-calls.json'),request,candidate['hecate_source'])
                if 'upstream_exercise' in request:
                    from upstream_helper_coverage import verify_trace
                    item['upstream_helper_coverage']=verify_trace(item['static_check']['upstream_exercise'],read_json(output/'upstream-calls.json'))
            if unified and "construction_profile" in request:
                observed=read_json(output/"construction.json")
                require(observed==item["static_check"]["public_construction"],
                        "Actual public normalization differs from checked metadata")
                require(digest(output/"normalized-source.py")==observed["normalized_sha256"],
                        "Normalized source hash mismatch")
                derived=read_json(output/"derived-constants.json")
                from benchmark_graph import digest as data_digest
                require(data_digest(derived)==observed["derived_constants_sha256"],
                        "Derived constants hash mismatch")
                events=read_json(output/"public-construction-events.json")
                require(events["profile"]==request["construction_profile"] and
                        events["normalized_sha256"]==observed["normalized_sha256"] and
                        events["candidate_python_executed"] is False,
                        "Actual public construction trace identity")
                item["public_construction_trace"]=dict(profile=events["profile"],events=len(events["events"]),
                    real_frontend_checked=item["trace"]["frontend"]=="real_Hecate",
                    source_and_normalization_bound=True,directed_features_validated=False)
                if "construction_exercise" in request:
                    from unified_public_coverage import verify_trace_coverage
                    item["public_expression_coverage"]=verify_trace_coverage(
                        item["static_check"]["construction_exercise"],events)
                    item["public_construction_trace"]["directed_features_validated"]=True

            if request['task']=='hecate-periodic-packed-native-synthesis-v2' or (unified and 'construction_exercise' in request and "construction_profile" not in request):
                if unified:
                    from unified_native_coverage import verify_trace_coverage
                else:
                    from packed_native_exercises import verify_trace_coverage
                records={key:read_json(output/file) for key,file in (
                    ('storage','native-array-events.json'),('star','native-star-events.json'),
                    ('augmented','native-augmented-events.json'),('mutation','native-array-mutation-events.json'),
                    ('calls','native-call-events.json'))}
                item['packed_native_coverage']=verify_trace_coverage(
                    item['static_check']['construction_exercise'],records)
            if request['task'] == 'hecate-native-function-synthesis-v2':
                from native_function_exercises import verify_trace_coverage
                item['native_call_coverage'] = verify_trace_coverage(
                    item['static_check']['construction_exercise'], read_json(output/'native-call-events.json'))
            if request['task'] == 'hecate-native-function-synthesis-v4':
                from native_array_exercises import verify_trace_coverage
                item['native_array_coverage'] = verify_trace_coverage(
                    item['static_check']['construction_exercise'], read_json(output/'native-array-events.json'))
            if request['task'] == 'hecate-native-function-synthesis-v8':
                from native_star_exercises import verify_trace_coverage
                item['native_star_coverage'] = verify_trace_coverage(
                    item['static_check']['construction_exercise'], read_json(output/'native-star-events.json'))
            stage = "compiler"
            from poseidon_runtime_compile import command as compile_command, prepare_entrypoint
            from poseidon_validation import gate, prepare_inputs, execute
            require(request.get("compiler_configuration",{}).get("backend")=="poseidon_cpu",
                    "Poseidon CPU configuration required; no legacy backend execution")
            item["runtime_plan_entry"] = prepare_entrypoint(output, request["compiler_configuration"])
            command = compile_command(waterline, entry_policy=request["compiler_configuration"].get("runtime_plan_entry_policy"))
            item["compile_command"] = command
            code = native_run(trace_payload, output, command, attempt / "compile.log")
            require(code == 0, f"Isolated compiler failed (exit {code}); see compile.log")
            item["compiled"] = True
            stage = "artifact_gate"
            item["artifact_gate"] = gate(output, request)
            if context.validation_level == "compiled":
                artifact_hashes = {str(p.relative_to(output)): digest(p) for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
                item.update(status="passed", validation_level="compiled", compiled_validated=True)
                # finally still verifies frozen inputs/artifacts and persists the attempt.
                # The common feedback construction below handles integrity overrides.
                raise CompilationAccepted()
            stage = "resource_gate"
            from application_planning.compiled_resources import execution_storage_precheck
            item["resource_analysis"] = execution_storage_precheck(output, request)
            artifact_hashes = prepare_inputs(result, output, request)
            stage = "poseidon_runtime"
            execution = execute(trace_payload, output, request, native_run, attempt / "execute.log")
            item.update(executed=True, execution=execution)
            stage = "numerical_comparison"
            with np.load(result / "arrays.npz", allow_pickle=False) as data:
                item["comparison"] = compare(np.load(output / "decrypted.npy", allow_pickle=False),
                                             data["reference"], fixed["atol"], fixed["rtol"])
                if 'execution_abi' in request['layout'] and len(request['layout']['output_shape'])>1:
                    from packed_input_abi import decode_output
                    logical=np.load(output/'decrypted-logical.npy',allow_pickle=False)
                    expected=decode_output(np.load(output/'decrypted.npy',allow_pickle=False),request['layout'])
                    require(np.array_equal(logical,expected) and logical.shape==data['reference_logical'].shape,
                            'Logical output shape/order differs from declared binding')
                    item['logical_output_shape']=list(logical.shape[1:])
                    item['logical_output_sha256']=digest(output/'decrypted-logical.npy')
            require(item["comparison"]["passed"], "Frozen numerical tolerance failed; inspect reduction/layout/operator semantics")
            item.update(status="passed", numerically_correct=True)
        except CompilationAccepted:
            pass
        except Exception as error:
            from application_planning.compiled_resources import (CompiledStorageRejected,
                                                                 CompiledResourceIntegrityRejected)
            from poseidon_artifact_gate import DuplicateFinalOutput
            if isinstance(error, DuplicateFinalOutput):
                stage = "artifact_gate"
                item["structured_diagnostic"] = error.structured_diagnostic()
            if isinstance(error, CompiledStorageRejected):
                stage = "resource_gate"
                item["resource_analysis"] = error.analysis
                item["structured_diagnostic"] = error.structured_diagnostic()

def _stage(status, code):
    return dict(status=status, code=code)


def _resource(value, certainty, basis, bound=None):
    result = dict(value=value, certainty=certainty, basis=basis)
    if bound is not None:
        result["bound"] = bound
    return result


def _report(backend):
    return dict(
        format=REPORT, capability_version=VERSION, backend=backend,
        admission="rejected", execution_readiness="unknown",
        stages={name: _stage("unverified", "not_checked") for name in STAGES},
        resources={}, diagnostics=[], identity={},
        evidence_scope="request preflight only",
        encrypted_execution=False, numerically_validated=False, paid_calls=0,
    )


def _finish(report):
    # This compact summary deliberately excludes graph labels, model/request hashes,
    # arbitrary diagnostics and public values. Context selection may depend on it.
    report["summary"] = dict(
        admission=report["admission"], execution_readiness=report["execution_readiness"],
        stages={name: copy.deepcopy(report["stages"][name]) for name in STAGES},
        resource_profile=report.get("resource_profile"),
        resources={name: dict(value=item["value"], certainty=item["certainty"])
                   for name, item in report["resources"].items() if name != "model_json_bytes"},
    )
    return report


def _reject(report, stage, code, message, *, status="rejected"):
    report["stages"][stage] = _stage(status, code)
    report["diagnostics"].append(dict(stage=stage, code=code, message=message))
    return _finish(report)


def _check_requirements(report, requirements):
    if requirements is None:
        return None
    if (type(requirements) is not dict or set(requirements) - {"bootstrap"} or
            ("bootstrap" in requirements and type(requirements["bootstrap"]) is not bool)):
        return _reject(report, "input", "requirements_invalid",
                       "Requirements accept only an explicit bootstrap boolean.")
    if requirements.get("bootstrap"):
        return _reject(report, "encrypted", "bootstrap_unavailable",
                       "The active Poseidon application contract does not expose bootstrap.",
                       status="blocked")
    return None


def _input_shape_rejection(report, model, profile):
    """Give stable public diagnostics before the detailed trusted graph validator."""
    specs = model.get("inputs")
    if type(specs) is list:
        for spec in specs:
            if type(spec) is not dict:
                continue
            # Model graph declarations have no dtype field. A typed source frontend
            # must normalize to the existing fixed float64 graph contract first.
            if "dtype" in spec:
                return _reject(report, "input", "dtype_declaration_unsupported",
                               "Graph input declarations use name and shape; dtype is fixed to float64.")
            shape = spec.get("shape")
            if type(shape) is list and not 1 <= len(shape) <= PROFILES[profile].rank:
                return _reject(report, "input", "rank_not_supported",
                               "Input tensor rank is outside the selected resource profile.")
    return None


def _logical_resources(report, original, lowered, checked, profile):
    shapes = checked["shapes"]
    elements = lambda name: math.prod(shapes[name])
    output_elements = sum(elements(o["value"]) for o in lowered["outputs"])
    report["resource_profile"] = profile
    report["resources"] = {
        "logical_inputs": _resource(len(lowered["inputs"]), "exact", "validated declarations"),
        "logical_outputs": _resource(len(lowered["outputs"]), "exact", "validated declarations"),
        "input_elements": _resource(sum(elements(i["name"]) for i in lowered["inputs"]),
                                    "exact", "validated shapes"),
        "output_elements": _resource(output_elements, "exact", "validated named output shapes"),
        "original_nodes": _resource(len(original["nodes"]), "exact", "submitted graph"),
        "expanded_nodes": _resource(len(lowered["nodes"]), "exact", "validated core graph"),
        "largest_logical_tensor": _resource(
            max((elements(name) for name in shapes if checked["kinds"][name] == "cipher"), default=0),
            "exact", "validated encrypted tensor shapes"),
        "public_constant_elements": _resource(
            sum(elements(name) for name in lowered["constants"]), "exact", "validated public constants"),
        "model_json_bytes": _resource(len(canonical(lowered)), "exact", "canonical lowered model"),
        # The request binds I/O only. Internal layouts, operation ordering, live
        # ciphertexts, key storage and multiplicative depth require the candidate.
        "intermediate_ciphertexts": _resource(None, "unknown", "requires compiled candidate"),
        "multiplicative_depth": _resource(None, "unknown", "requires compiled candidate"),
        "peak_memory_bytes": _resource(None, "unknown", "requires compiled candidate and runtime"),
        "execution_seconds": _resource(None, "unknown", "requires measured execution"),
    }


def _bind_request(report, request):
    layout = request["layout"]
    model_inputs = len(layout["inputs"])
    auxiliary = len(layout["auxiliary_ciphertexts"])
    outputs = layout["output_ciphertexts"]
    report["resources"].update({
        "input_ciphertexts": _resource(model_inputs, "exact", "canonical bound model inputs"),
        "auxiliary_ciphertexts": _resource(auxiliary, "exact", "trusted encrypted zero binding"),
        "output_ciphertexts": _resource(outputs, "exact", "canonical bound output selectors"),
        "slot_period": _resource(layout["input_slot_period"], "exact", "canonical layout"),
        # This lower bound counts separately encrypted inputs only. Outputs can
        # alias, so their count cannot raise the bound. It is not a peak memory
        # estimate or a budget sufficiency claim.
        "ciphertext_objects_lower_bound": _resource(
            model_inputs + auxiliary, "conservative",
            "trusted input preparation encrypts each physical input and the auxiliary zero separately",
            bound="lower"),
    })
    report["layout"] = dict(execution_abi=layout["execution_abi"], sha256=digest(layout))
    report["identity"].update(request_id=request["request_id"],
                              compiler_configuration_sha256=request["compiler_configuration"]["identity_sha256"],
                              lowered_model_sha256=digest(request["model"]))
    report["stages"]["layout"] = _stage("accepted", "canonical_binding_prepared")
    report["stages"]["compiler"] = _stage("unverified", "candidate_not_compiled")
    report["stages"]["encrypted"] = _stage("unverified", "candidate_not_executed")
    report["stages"]["agent"] = _stage("unverified", "candidate_not_generated")
    report["admission"] = "accepted_pending_validation"
    return _finish(report)


def _preparation_error(report, error):
    # Map a bounded set of trusted contract diagnostics to public codes. Never
    # forward arbitrary exception text (which can contain local dependency paths).
    text = str(error)
    if "Capacity helper profile" in text:
        code, message = "capacity_helper_unverified", "Capacity layouts cannot select an upstream helper profile."
    elif any(part in text for part in ("period", "ciphertext budget", "execution ABI", "layout binding")):
        code, message = "layout_not_supported", "The requested layout is outside the canonical layout contract."
    elif any(part in text for part in ("helper", "Helper", "composition", "Composition")):
        code, message = "construction_combination_unsupported", "The selected helper or construction combination is not supported."
    elif "Component option fields" in text:
        code, message = "options_invalid", "Unknown or malformed component options."
    else:
        code, message = "preparation_rejected", "The model or selected options fail request preparation."
    return _reject(report, "layout", code, message)


def assess_model(model, *, options=None, backend=BACKEND, resource_profile=None,
                 dtype="float64", requirements=None):
    """Validate a graph and its request binding without compiling or generating DSL.

    High-level operator graphs are checked through the existing recursive
    decomposition. This is an assessment API, not a new task submission path.
    It deliberately does not return lowered code or a deterministic DSL answer.
    """
    report = _report(backend)
    if backend != BACKEND:
        return _reject(report, "input", "backend_not_supported",
                       "This application entry accepts the Poseidon CPU backend.")
    if type(dtype) is not str or dtype != "float64":
        return _reject(report, "input", "dtype_not_supported", "Input dtype must be float64.")
    rejected = _check_requirements(report, requirements)
    if rejected is not None:
        return rejected
    if type(model) is not dict or model.get("format") not in (FORMAT, CAPACITY_FORMAT, *OPERATOR_FORMATS):
        return _reject(report, "input", "graph_format_unsupported", "Select a versioned model or operator graph.")
    if options is not None and type(options) is not dict:
        return _reject(report, "input", "options_invalid", "Component options must be an object.")
    options = copy.deepcopy(options or {})
    if options.get("compiler_configuration", "poseidon-cpu-eva-w45-v1") not in CPU_CONFIGURATIONS:
        return _reject(report, "compiler", "compiler_backend_not_supported",
                       "New application requests require an active Poseidon CPU configuration.", status="blocked")
    high = model["format"] in OPERATOR_FORMATS
    try:
        profile = (resource_profile or "legacy-v1") if high else graph_resource_profile(model)
        resource_identity(profile)
        if not high and resource_profile is not None and resource_profile != profile:
            return _reject(report, "input", "resource_profile_mismatch",
                           "The selected profile differs from the model's bound resource profile.")
        rejected = _input_shape_rejection(report, model, profile)
        if rejected is not None:
            return rejected
        report["identity"]["original_model_sha256"] = digest(model)
        if high:
            lowered, binding = decompose(copy.deepcopy(model), resource_profile=profile)
            report["decomposition"] = dict(
                binding_sha256=binding["binding_sha256"],
                registry_version=binding["registry_version"],
                implementation_sha256=binding["implementation_sha256"],
                original_sha256=binding["original_sha256"],
                lowered_sha256=binding["lowered_sha256"])
            report["stages"]["decomposition"] = _stage("accepted", "bounded_decomposition_validated")
            options=preparation_options(model,lowered,options)
        else:
            lowered = copy.deepcopy(model)
            report["stages"]["decomposition"] = _stage("not_required", "core_graph_submitted")
        checked = validate(lowered)
        report["stages"]["input"] = _stage("accepted", "logical_graph_validated")
        _logical_resources(report, model, lowered, checked, profile)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, OverflowError, RecursionError):
        return _reject(report, "decomposition" if high else "input",
                       "decomposition_rejected" if high else "graph_invalid",
                       "The graph violates registered operator, type, shape, approximation or resource constraints.")
    if lowered["format"] == CAPACITY_FORMAT and options.get("helper_profile") is not None:
        return _reject(report, "layout", "capacity_helper_unverified",
                       "Capacity layouts cannot select an upstream helper profile.", status="blocked")
    try:
        # Lazy import avoids a dependency cycle if the old component facade later
        # delegates its declarations to this module.
        from component_contract import prepare_task
        request = prepare_task(lowered, options)
        validate_request(request)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, OverflowError, RecursionError) as error:
        return _preparation_error(report, error)
    return _bind_request(report, request)
